description: Get the current stock quote for a company: price, volume, change, market cap and other real-time market data. Trading-halt fields halted, haltCode, haltReason, haltedAt and resumptionAt are present on every response (false/null when trading normally); a halted ticker returns the last-known quote instead of an error, or currentPrice null with halted true when nothing is recoverable. `priceAsOfDate` is the ET date the price printed (`priceAsOf` the trade time when known), not when it was read; null means the print date was not measured. `priceIsStale: true` means the price is an older held close (the last trade on that date), not a current trading price. `quoteSource: "screener_reference"` (foreign listings on US OTC that file nothing with the SEC, e.g. PGPHF) means `currentPrice` is a vendor reference price whose print date is not known, and every other market field is null (not measured). `marketCap` is the live price times the SEC-derived share count; when that count is unavailable it is null with `marketCapWithheldReason` set, which means not measured, not zero and not "no market cap". The count is `sharesOutstanding`, dated by `sharesOutstandingAsOf` and `sharesOutstandingAsOfKind` ("stated" = the issuer's statement date; "checked" = when it was last confirmed against a vendor; "none" = date not recorded), with a vendor-free `sharesOutstandingSource`. When no measured count exists, `sharesOutstanding` and `marketCap` are a best estimate (the newest dated filed or reference count, moved onto today's split basis): `sharesOutstandingEstimated: true`, `sharesOutstandingEstimateKind` and `marketCapEstimated: true` with `marketCapAsOf` (the count's date). Kind "stated_as_of" is the issuer's last stated count, a dated point rather than a bound or today's count; later issuances recorded in the filings are listed in `statedAsOf.events`, not added to it ("at_least" is the retired name of the same state).
name: get_quote
title: Get Stock Quote
